title: Campaign Descriptor
description: Everything a campaign-specific about running the shared toolkit: its measured project, its recorded identities, its declarations, its engine names and how its published pages and reports are named. The toolkit reads this file and holds no campaign-specific value of its own.

identities.description: Which library revisions a run records: `library` alone, or `library` plus `upstream` (a baseline the measured library is compared against).

features.description: The harness feature per vendor arm, when the build selects its vendor with a cargo feature. The recorder appends the selected arm's entry to the suite's own `features` and exports the result to the build as `BENCH_FEATURES`. A campaign whose build script takes the vendor from the environment (for example `BENCH_VENDOR`, which the recorder always exports) omits this: the field is optional.

provider_packages.description: Package names whose linked revisions are the measured provider's provenance, read from the checkout's lock file.

pin_env.description: The variable names the build script writes into its output file.

build_argv.description: How the recorder invokes the build script, as a template. Tokens: {build_script} {checkout} {upstream} {out} {binary} {vendor}. Defaults to `{build_script} {checkout} {out} {binary}`.

protocol.description: Where the pinned/idle timing protocol lives: in the measured checkout, or in this campaign repository.

harness_args.description: Extra arguments appended after the harness subcommand for every `verify` and `run` invocation (for example an input corpus path the recorder cannot infer). Not passed to `info`.

upstream.description: The optional second recorded identity (a baseline), required when `identities` names `upstream`.

engines.description: Engine name the harness emits -> provider.

vendor_providers.description: Providers that own the BLAS/LAPACK symbols. They are mutually exclusive in one process, so they are the axis a run -- and a page -- is split on.

external_providers.description: Providers that are neither the measured library nor a vendor: a baseline linked against a separately built library (TBLIS, for example). A campaign that records one declares its provider names here so the recorder attributes its engine rows to a collected identity, and refuses the run when that identity -- at least a non-empty commit -- is not supplied.

loader_paths.description: Directories prepended to the measured process's `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, so the harness can load a library built outside the measured checkout (the `lib`/`lib64` directories of an external provider's installation, for example). Each path is expanded from the environment, so a campaign may write `$SOME_ROOT/lib`; an inherited `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` is kept after them. A campaign that declares none leaves the variable exactly as the recorder found it.

vendor_env.description: Thread-budget and tuning variables that belong to a vendor library, removed from the measured process's environment.

csv_columns.description: The columns the harness's CSV must carry, as the report and the comparison read them.

case_axes.description: CSV columns, beyond regime/family/dtype/shape/batch/row/threads, that identify a cell. A declared axis is part of the key a report table and a comparison are grouped by -- two values are two cells and are never pooled -- and it is printed in the case label and in each report section heading. `k`, the third index of a three-index shape, is read from the CSV whenever the column is declared and needs no entry here.

case_label.description: Template naming one cell in a report table and in a comparison. Tokens: {regime} {family} {dtype} {dims} {batch} {row} {threads}, plus each name in `case_axes`. Defaults to the shape of an un-axed campaign: `` `{family}/{dims}/b{batch}` @{threads}T {row} ``.

page_name.description: Template naming a published page. Tokens: {library12} {upstream12} {version} {vendor} {dirty} {timing}. The timing token is empty for v1 and -timing-vN for later policies. For example `{library12}{version}{vendor}{dirty}` for one measured revision, or `{library12}-{upstream12}{vendor}{dirty}` when a baseline is recorded too.

default_invalidated_by.description: Paths in the measured repository whose commits make an existing result out of date, when a suite declaration does not state its own.

report.description: The strings the generated index and report headers print.

library_version_label.description: Label of the line that prints the measured revision's own version, when the manifest records one. Omitted when the measured library carries no release version of its own.

upstream_label.description: Label of the line that prints the baseline revision, when the descriptor records a second identity.

upstream_ref_label.description: Label of the line that prints the ref and version the baseline revision was pinned by, so the pin reads as a release and not only as a hash.

verify_note.description: The paragraph a report prints above its tables about what the harness's `verify` pass established, as a literal block scalar: one line per output line. Token: {binary}. Defaults to the wording of the first campaign extracted.
